title: Explain an entity’s verification
responsibility: Shows the verification result for an entity at the displayed commit, keeping missing or unreadable evidence distinct from failed verification.

inputs.name: evidenceVerdict.read
inputs.description: The evidence read state, optional result and failure text. Idle and planned states use the catalog judgment; loading, unavailable and failed reads produce an unknown judgment with an explanation.

inputs.name: evidenceVerdict.entity
inputs.description: The entity identity and kind, plus its catalog verification status and note. The identity selects the unit within the evidence; the catalog status is used only before an evidence judgment is available.

inputs.name: evidenceVerdict.commit
inputs.description: The displayed commit to compare with the after side of the evidence. Evidence for another commit produces an unknown judgment.

outputs.name: evidenceVerdict
outputs.description: A status and readable reason. Idle or planned reads repeat the catalog status and note. Otherwise missing, unreadable, mismatched or unrecorded evidence is unknown. A matching side with the entity and a verification record uses the reports verdict: verified when it passes, failed otherwise, with its reasons.
